terminal_name: Basrah Gas Company expansion (BNGL / associated-gas project)
issue: Egypt Oil & Gas and Iraqi News Agency reporting (2025-2026) on Basrah Gas Company's associated-gas processing expansion uses the term 'LNG exports' for planned surplus-gas monetization, which would make this a new-terminal discovery candidate if genuine (methane LNG export by ship). Cross-checked against Basrah Gas Company's own website (project scope explicitly LPG/propane/butane/condensate only, no methane liquefaction/export facility described) and MEES trade press (volume figures cited for 'LPG' closely track the tonnage the other outlets label 'LNG'). Concluded this is very likely a media mislabeling of an LPG expansion (Basrah Natural Gas Liquids project) rather than a genuine LNG (methane) export terminal. Per the scope-gate rule (resolve scope doubt before staging, never stage-with-doubt), NOT staged as new_terminal or monitor_list -- logging here instead so a future batch can re-check if BGC ever announces an explicit methane-liquefaction facility.
suggested_action: Recheck if Basrah Gas Company or Iraq's Ministry of Oil ever announces a dedicated methane liquefaction/LNG export facility (distinct from the LPG/NGL expansion).

suggested_action: No candidates cleared the threshold this cycle; re-sweep TotalEnergies GGIP and BGC expansion news next batch given active associated-gas investment in Iraq.
